# Approval-Flow State & Data Requirements Checklist: F119 E-Blast Two-Sided Approval

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements that describe stages, versions, decisions, schedule, allowance and expiry — are they complete, unambiguous, consistent and measurable before `/speckit.tasks`?
**Created**: 2026-09-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. It is reviewer-owned: `[x]` means the reviewer judged the requirements-quality criterion satisfied — it never means implementation is done. `/speckit.implement` reads this state but does not change it.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is every stage in the FR-019 list given an entry condition, an exit condition and the actor who triggers each exit, so that no stage's transitions are left to inference? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): state table lives in data-model.md § state machine; FR-019 needs a one-line pointer
- [x] CHK002 Are the closed outcomes (Rejected, Withdrawn/Cancelled, Expired — no member response, Failed) each defined with who can cause them and from which stages? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, §FR-022a]
- [x] CHK003 Is "In design" defined precisely — what event starts it, whether the member is told, and whether more than one marketing user can hold it? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §Edge Cases] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): not stated whether the member is told when design starts
- [x] CHK004 Does the spec state what marketing sees and can do with an E-Blast in "Changes requested by member" that it does NOT want to fix (reject vs. send unchanged version)? [Gap, Spec §FR-011] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): marketing's options on a change request it disagrees with are not stated
- [x] CHK005 Are the contents of a "version" enumerated (subject, body, note, author, sent-at, approved flag) and is it stated which of these are immutable once sent to the member? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities, §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK006 Is the round counter defined — what increments it, whether a withdrawn approval starts a new round, and where it is displayed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026, §US2-AS3] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): what increments the round, and whether a withdrawn approval starts a new round, is undefined
- [x] CHK007 Are requirements defined for the approve-as-submitted path's history (does version 0 exist, is a "no changes" decision recorded)? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, §FR-032] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): history of the approve-as-submitted path (is there a version 0 / a decision record) is undefined

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Is "any content change after member approval voids the approval" bounded — does changing only the note, or only the schedule, count as content? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): "content change" not bounded — note-only or schedule-only edits
- [x] CHK009 Is "sending begins" defined as a specific observable moment (dispatch picked up vs. provider accepted) so FR-015/FR-015a cut-offs are testable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, §FR-015a] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): "sending begins" has no observable definition
- [x] CHK010 Is the expiry clock's start ("the moment the version was sent to the member") unambiguous when a second version is sent — does the clock restart from the latest version only? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022a]
- [x] CHK011 Is "whose turn it is" defined for every stage, including Scheduled/Sending where neither side acts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): "whose turn" undefined for Scheduled / Sending
- [x] CHK012 Is the "existing minimum lead time" named with its value so the schedule-confirmation rule can be tested without reading code? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): minimum lead time value (today 5 min) not named in the spec

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Do FR-012a's two trigger exemptions cover every write the spec elsewhere requires (promotion, confirm, change, cancel-on-withdrawal, expiry close) and no more? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012a vs §FR-015a, §FR-017, §FR-022a]
- [x] CHK014 Is the set of "in-progress stages" used by FR-020 (allowance held) identical to the set used by the erasure/cancel cascade and by the stalled flag in FR-027? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, §FR-027, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK015 Does the flag-off rule (FR-034: mid-flow rows stay completable) agree with the plan's "flag gates entry only" and with US7-AS1/AS3? [Consistency, Spec §FR-034, §US7]
- [x] CHK016 Are the stage names used identically across FR-019, the user-story acceptance scenarios, the dashboard requirements and the notification requirements (e.g. "Awaiting member approval" everywhere)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, §US1-AS2, §FR-025]
- [x] CHK017 Does the member's proposed send time survive a withdrawn approval and a new round, or is it re-proposed — and do FR-016 and FR-015a agree? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, §FR-015a]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 Can SC-002 ("100% … provable from the history") be verified from the requirements alone — is the history required to record the exact approved version identity and the approving user? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, §FR-032]
- [x] CHK019 Can SC-007 be checked without knowing the allowance implementation — is "allowance place" defined as a countable thing in the spec? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007, §FR-020]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK021 Are requirements defined for a marketing user sending a new version while the member's withdrawal-of-approval arrives at the same moment (which wins, what each sees)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases "act at the same moment", §FR-033]
- [x] CHK022 Are requirements defined for an E-Blast that expires (day 30) after marketing already confirmed a schedule — is that state reachable, and if so is the schedule cancelled? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-022a, §FR-017] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): not stated that expiry cannot occur after member approval / after a confirmed schedule
- [x] CHK023 Are requirements defined for the day-23 warning when the member acts on day 24–29 (is the expiry cancelled, is a second warning ever sent)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-022a]
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements defined for a member whose portal access lapses while an E-Blast awaits their approval — can they still approve, does expiry still run? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases "membership lapses"] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): whether a lapsed member can still approve, and whether expiry keeps running, is not stated
- [x] CHK025 Are requirements defined for an E-Blast submitted by staff on the member's behalf that then needs member sign-off — who on the member side is notified when no portal user exists? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases "staff submits on behalf", §FR-013] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): proxy-submitted E-Blast with no portal user on the member side is not covered
- [x] CHK026 Are requirements defined for the pre-existing rows in `submitted` at the moment the flag turns on (do they get the new actions, and is that intended)? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Feature flag] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): rows already in `submitted` when the flag turns on are not covered
